name: Sundial
summary: An architecture studio site where scrolling plays a sunset over a lake house, drawn live on canvas
about: A one-page website for an architecture studio. The hero is a canvas film: as you scroll, the sun sets over a lake house, shadows stretch, windows light up one by one and the stars come out, with a time dial you can drag or play. Below it sit filterable projects with a day and night view, a working sun-path study for Pakistani cities, a scroll-drawn process and an enquiry form. Good for architects, interior designers and real estate brands.
how: The film opens: letterbox bars slide away, the house rises into place and the headline words spring up
Scroll down and the sunset plays: the sun drops, the sky turns gold, pink and blue, and the house lights up room by room
Drag the time dial to scrub the film, or press play to watch it run on its own; any scroll pauses it
Filter the projects, open one to read about it, flip it between day and night and step to the next
In the sun study, pick a date, a city, an hour and a facing to see the sun path and the house's shadow, or play the whole day
Send the enquiry form: it checks each field, shows its sending stages, celebrates, and Send another resets it
